description.value:
You've grown accustomed to the unpredictable and ever-changing nature of the Ghost Levels. You become trained in Survival or become an expert in it if you were already trained. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Urban Survivalist] skill feat.

Additionally, you've learned how to create and interpret coded symbols used for communication on the Ghost Levels. You learn the Courier Marks language, a language that's only expressed in written symbols. You can always [[/act decipher-writing skill=occultism]] using Occultism.
